seoTitle: Code to Image: Code Screenshot Maker (PNG)
metaDescription: Turn a code snippet into a shareable PNG with syntax colours, window controls, line numbers and a gradient background.
intro: Make a good-looking picture of code for posts, slides and docs.
why:
Paste the code, choose a language (JavaScript, Python, JSON, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, Rust, shell or plain), a dark or light theme, font size, padding, background and scale. Keywords, strings, numbers and comments are coloured with simple pattern rules, and the image is drawn on a canvas with a window title bar, optional line numbers and rounded corners, then saved as PNG.

Colours come from pattern matching, not a full parser, so unusual syntax may be tinted imperfectly. Images are drawn in your browser; the code is not uploaded.

The file is read in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.

faq.a: Your system's monospace font, so the image looks different on different computers.

faq.q: Is code text kept for accessibility?
faq.a: No, the image is pixels; add alt text or include the code as text.
The file is read in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
